## Solution

**Setup.** Contestant $n$ has height $x_n(t) = t^n$. The speed is the time derivative:
$$v_n(t) = \frac{d}{dt}t^n = n\,t^{n-1}.$$

At $t = 2$:
$$v_n(2) = n\cdot 2^{n-1}.$$

**Average speed.**
$$\bar v = \frac{1}{10}\sum_{n=1}^{10} n\,2^{n-1}.$$

**Computing the sum.** Using the closed form $\sum_{n=1}^{N} n\,r^{n-1} = \frac{1-(N+1)r^N + N\,r^{N+1}}{(1-r)^2}$ with $r=2$, $N=10$:

$$\sum_{n=1}^{10} n\,2^{n-1} = \frac{1 - 11\cdot 2^{10} + 10\cdot 2^{11}}{(1-2)^2} = 1 - 11\cdot 1024 + 10\cdot 2048 = 1 - 11264 + 20480 = 9217.$$

**Verification by direct summation:**
$$1 + 4 + 12 + 32 + 80 + 192 + 448 + 1024 + 2304 + 5120 = 9217.\ \checkmark$$

**Final value.**
$$x = \bar v = \frac{9217}{10} = 921.7,$$
$$\lfloor 10^{1}\cdot x\rfloor = \lfloor 10 \cdot 921.7\rfloor = \lfloor 9217\rfloor = \boxed{9217}.$$
